# B07 — Open a window onto the workshop

[START](../../guide/00-START.md). Depends: B06. Outcome: the owner can open a live work view, reconnect, and control work without inventing progress.

Read `server/http/routes/work.ts` (planned), `server/events/event-bus.ts`, `server/realtime/`, `src/ui/App.tsx`, `src/ui/Presence.tsx`. Load only functions for the active slice. Existing tests: `tests/work/`, `tests/realtime/`. New tests belong beside the behavior.

## Slices

- **s1:** Read path. Implement `GET /api/work` (list) and `GET /api/work/:id` snapshot, plus a per-job SSE stream (`GET /api/work/:id/events?cursor=`). Snapshot returns `WorkSnapshot` with version, status, `controlIntent`, step summaries, artifact descriptors and allowed controls. SSE is version-ordered, cursor-resumable, deduplicates by `eventId`. Test idempotent reads, access control, cursor resume and dedup.
- **s2:** Workspace. Implement `src/ui/WorkView.tsx` showing goal, current step, verified steps, latest actual artifact (resolved bytes, `content_hash` badge), blockers and controls `pause/resume/cancel`. Implement `src/state/useWork.ts` (SSE → projection with version reject + event dedup). No invented percentages; indeterminate phase shows elapsed time. Test rendering against real snapshots and events.
- **s3:** Control + reconnect. Implement `POST /api/work/:id/{pause,resume,cancel}` with `{requestId, expectedVersion}`; stale version yields 409 with current version; duplicate `requestId` returns original result. Define hide vs cancel vs stop-speaking: hide is local only (no API call), tab close does not cancel, `stopSpeaking` flushes audio for one `responseId` without cancelling the job. Test hide-vs-cancel, 409/retry, duplicate request, and reconnect gap → snapshot refetch.

Add numbered migrations only after inspecting the latest migration list; never rewrite applied SQL. Each slice must first exhibit the defect. Do not bundle all three into one small-model prompt.

## Gate

J04 and J05 pass via real routes: running work shows actual steps and latest artifact version; hiding/closing the view does not cancel the job; reconnect shows the latest durable snapshot and retains the artifact. No fake progress, no mock in production. Preserve baseline unrelated failures explicitly.

Next: B08/s1. No model replacement here.
